tour.welcome.title: Welcome to LumiLivre!
tour.welcome.body: Let's take a quick tour of the panel's main areas. It takes less than a minute.
tour.sidebar.title: Navigation
tour.sidebar.body: Use the sidebar to reach Home, Books, Readers, Loans, Contents and more. Hover to expand it or pin it in place.
tour.search.title: Global search
tour.search.body: Quickly jump to any screen. You can also open it with Ctrl/⌘ + K.
tour.notifications.title: Notifications
tour.notifications.body: Keep an eye here: overdue loans and new requests show up in real time.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Adjust library type, language, theme and — if you're an admin — app version, audit and users.
tour.finish.title: All set!
tour.finish.body: You're ready to explore. This tour won't show again.
apiHealth.title: Waking the server…
apiHealth.waking_message: The server was asleep to save resources. We're bringing it back — this usually takes up to ~1 minute. You didn't lose anything; the screen will resume on its own.
apiHealth.down_message: We couldn't wake the server in time. Please try again shortly, or contact support if it persists.
